description: Returns one opportunity's full record: title, funder, deadline, status, eligibility, award amounts when stated, the official notice and application links, and up to 12,000 characters of the stored source description. descriptionCoverage reports the returned and stored lengths and whether the text was cut. Input id: the id field of a search or calendar result. Does not count toward an account's search allowance. Without an account, record reads count toward a daily record allowance.
